episodeTitle.en: Scale AI CEO on Meta’s $14B deal, scaling Uber Eats to $80B, & what frontier labs are building next
episodeTitle.zh: Scale AI CEO谈元宇宙140亿美元交易、Uber Eats如何扩张至800亿美元，以及前沿实验室的未来方向

guestBioOfficial.en: Jason Droege is the CEO of Scale AI, a company that provides foundational training data to every major AI lab. He previously co-founded Scour with Travis Kalanick and built Uber Eats from idea to $20 billion in revenue. In this conversation, Jason shares lessons from getting sued for $250 billion, discovering restaurant economics by weighing sandwich ingredients, and over 25 years of launching transformative technology businesses. *What you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰森·德罗格（Jason Droege）是Scale AI的首席执行官，该公司为各大AI实验室提供基础训练数据。此前，他与特拉维斯·卡兰尼克（Travis Kalanick）共同创立了Scour，并将Uber Eats从一个创意发展为年营收200亿美元的业务。在本次对谈中，杰森分享了被索赔2500亿美元的教训、通过称量三明治配料探索餐厅经济学的经验，以及25年多来创立变革性科技企业的心得。 *您将学到：*

title.en: Scale AI CEO on Meta’s $14B deal, scaling Uber Eats to $80B, & what frontier labs are building next
title.zh: Scale AI CEO谈元宇宙140亿美元交易、Uber Eats如何扩张至800亿美元，以及前沿实验室的未来方向

summary.en: Jason explains why enterprise AI takes 6–12 months to become robust enough to automate real processes, and why the trend is shifting from models that 'know things' to models that 'do things' via agents. He describes Scale's pioneering role in data labeling, training data, and evals—work that increasingly requires PhDs and professionals doing tasks that take hours—and how that is what actually makes frontier models smarter. The conversation also covers the high bar he sets for new businesses and what unique insight justifies starting one.
summary.zh: Jason 解释了为何企业级 AI 需要 6–12 个月才能足够稳健到自动化真实流程，以及为何趋势正从“知道事情”的模型转向通过智能体“做事”的模型。他描述了 Scale 在数据标注、训练数据和 evals 领域的开创性角色——这类工作越来越需要博士和专业人士完成耗时数小时的任务，而这正是前沿模型变聪明的真正来源。对话还涵盖他对新业务设定的高门槛，以及何种独特洞见才值得去创业。
